n5_reply.why: Withdrawn by hand when the listening banks were first built (08b83a76) as above N5: the prompt そこを何とか。 is a fixed plea (please, find some way) whose meaning is not the sum of its words, so validate_exam_level_gate, which checks words, kanji and grammar tags, cannot see what makes it hard. The build took the exclusion on the command line only, so every rebuild re-admitted it. W18 records it here, and build_listening_bank.py reads this file by default.
